newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch DAF Trucks to scale back production.
newsitem.headline: Dutch DAF Trucks to scale back production.

text.p: DAF Trucks NV said on Tuesday it would scale back production in November due to a fall in sales for medium-heavy trucks (over 15 tonnes).
But the company said the production slowdown would not affect full-year turnover and profit targets.
"We are maintaining our full-year production target of 17,500 to 18,000 trucks and see 1996 profit steady at 1995 levels," spokesman Hans Brian said.
DAF Trucks, the unlisted survivor of DAF NV which went bankrupt in 1993, posted 1995 net profit of 164 million guilders.
The firm, which manufactures solely to order, was currently producing around 80 vehicles a day but would scale this back to 65 from November 4, Brian said.
